items.title: Add a Program Pulse summary card to the portfolio overview
items.body:
Show one evidence-backed line per project on the program overview so a program manager can see what moved since the last visit.

Blocked by #314 until runs carry their issue reference.

items.title: Document the portfolio.json shape for operators
items.body: Operators author program, project and repository membership by hand. Explain each field, the optional project board, and what the work board shows when the document is invalid.

items.title: Compare MQTT vs NATS for IoT edge deployments
items.body: Research request: which of MQTT or NATS has lower latency on constrained ARM devices, and what does each cost in memory at idle? Needs sources the team can re-check.

items.body: The last attestation run for the canonical devcontainer profile was lost when the stack was reset. Re-run it and confirm the attested sandbox still satisfies the profile.

items.title: Stamp run.issue.ref when a run starts from a work item
items.body: A run started from an issue should carry its issue reference so the work board can show which runs belong to which work item without guessing.

items.body: The flat persona JSON files were never read; personas load by fragment directory. Delete them and their references.

items.title: Explain rule-fired controls in the run story
items.body: Render each rule-spawned control loop as one row: the rule, the firing fact and its value, the control identity and its outcome.

items.title: Index repository README and docs as document entities
items.body: Emit one document entity per README and docs page so downstream tools can cite them.

items.title: Support git submodule paths in the source manifest
items.body: A manifest entry that points inside a submodule is rejected today. Resolve it against the submodule checkout.

items.title: Fix duplicate entity ids for renamed files
items.body: A rename produced two entities for one file. Key the entity on the stable path history instead.
